text: LIVERPOOL PULL LEVEL! Played in by Jota's deflected pass from the right, Diaz flicks the ball up for himself and crashes past a helpless Neto to level the game up at 1-1! With great speed of thought, the winger skilfully steers the ball home from close range and brings the Anfield crowd to its feet.
Though Neto makes a superb save to keep Salah's penalty out, he then has to pick the ball out of the net when the Liverpool forward rams home the follow-up finish.

BOURNEMOUTH LEAD AT ANFIELD! Semenyo strikes unerringly into the bottom-right corner to put the Cherries in front! An error by Alexander-Arnold is not swept up by the Liverpool defence, and the Solanke prods the ball through a gap before Semenyo thumps it past Alisson: it's 1-0 to the visitors!

narrative_context: sudden early moment with little build-up
text: SAVE! Alexander-Arnold seeks redemption for his part in Bournemouth's goal, but is just denied by Neto, who tips his rasping drive from the right byline wide for a corner.
A good chance is spurned by Solanke, who powers in from the left before slashing his 18-yard shot well wide of the right-hand post.
However, the big striker leans back on his shot and sends the ball careering over the crossbar.
MISS! Konate's wait for a first Liverpool goal goes on, as he rises highest at the back post following a cross from the right but plants his header over the crossbar!
CLOSE! Having shrugged off both Konate and Mac Allister in midfield and then continued his run to the brink of the box, Semenyo unleashes a powerful swerving shot that zips just over the crossbar!

From a 25-yard free-kick in a central position, Billing steps up and laces a wild shot well over the crossbar; summing up Bournemouth's fortunes in the final third since going ahead in the third minute.
After a crossfield ball from Alexander-Arnold picks out Diaz on the edge of the area, the Colombian winger twice sees shots blocked before Szoboszlai slices an attempt wide of the right-hand post.

method: from outside the area, low shot
text: LIVERPOOL STRIKE! Making light of being one man down, the home side actually extend their lead! Within minutes of Mac Allister's sending-off, Szoboszlai drives in a low shot from outside the area, which Neto can only parry straight into the path of Jota, who then prods it over the line: 3-1 to Liverpool!
